title: 第一卷 第21章 雪岚 我才没有动情第一卷 第22章 多谢惠顾欢迎再来
slug: 人在废丹房从征服师姐开始成仙
content_zh:
;;
陈月的刺杀，对叶云而言就是个小插曲，同时提醒他已经被陈天傲盯上了。
因而在后续的这段时间，叶云在重塑两炉聚气丹后，就继续泡在废丹房之中艰苦地修炼。
哪怕陈天傲胆子再大，想来也不敢直接找人，到这废丹房中杀了他。
而就在几天的苦修，叶云修为顺利突破瓶颈达到凝气十一重！
“终于突破了！”
叶云深吸口气，如今距离三圣试炼还有十天，如果丹药充足，没准还真能冲上凝气巅峰！
只是再看手边的丹药，前几天刚重塑的两炉聚气丹，又已经只剩下三颗了。
“真是的，这丹药也太不禁吃了。”
不过要是让人知道他的修炼方法，估计吐槽上一句，就你这把丹药当饭吃，多少怕也不够！
就在叶云准备再修炼两天，然后想办法再搞点丹药。
忽然废丹房外，传来阵阵敲门声。
叶云愣了一下，好奇问道。
“是裴师姐吗？”
可转念一想，不对，如果是裴雨嫣的话，应该不会这么规规矩矩地敲门。
果然，门外旋即传来个熟悉的声音。
“是我，雪岚。”
叶云眼前一亮，当即迎了出去。
开门一看，果然是内门的雪岚师姐，还真有一阵没见到她了。
不知是不是伤势痊愈，眼前的雪岚师姐看起来，要比上一次面色红润了不少。

叶云当即笑着打了个招呼。
“雪岚师姐，您这可是稀客啊，莫非伤势已经好了？”
“多亏你的丹药，已经好了。”
雪岚微微点头，接着看了眼周围说道。
“这次过来想看看，你这位强大炼丹师，平时生活的地方。”
“咳咳，倒也算不上强大。”
对于炼丹师这个称呼，叶云还是有一内内的心虚。
好在雪岚的注意也没在这上面，相比之下，她更关注还是废丹房的环境。
当跟着叶云走进来后，她很快就皱了下眉头。
“好奇怪的味道，你就一直住这里？”
“没错，都习惯了。”
叶云淡淡一笑，却有点让雪岚刮目相看了。
有此炼丹技术，却还能沉下心，住在这种地方，怪不得他能有这般成就，当真有几分大师风范。
雪岚看了一圈后，对他赞许道。
“如今一看，我倒是对你有些钦佩了。”
闻言，叶云轻笑一声。
“那还真是不胜荣幸。”
由于废丹房环境杂乱，到处都散发着废丹的气息。
雪岚找了个好一会，才勉强找了个觉得干净的地方坐下，接着对叶云问道。
“对了，你去找过墨师姐了吧？见面还顺利吗？”

Chen Yue's assassination was just a minor episode for Ye Yun, and it also reminded him that Chen Tian'ao was targeting him.
Therefore, in the following period, after Ye Yun reshaped two furnaces of Qi Gathering Pills, he continued to practice hard in the waste pill room.
No matter how courageous Chen Tianao was, he wouldn't dare to find someone directly and kill him in this useless alchemy room.
And after just a few days of hard training, Ye Yun successfully broke through the bottleneck and reached the eleventh level of Qi Condensation!
"Finally a breakthrough!"
Ye Yun took a deep breath. There are still ten days left before the Three Saints Trial. If there are enough elixirs, he might be able to reach the peak of Qi Condensation!
Just looking at the pills at hand, there were only three left of the two furnaces of Qi Gathering Pills that had just been reshaped a few days ago.
"Really, I can't help but take this pill."
However, if people knew about his cultivation method, they would probably complain, "It's not enough for you to eat pills like food!"
Just as Ye Yun was preparing to practice for two more days, he would then find a way to get some more elixirs.
Suddenly, there were knocks on the door outside the Feidan room.
Ye Yun was stunned for a moment and asked curiously.
"Is it Senior Sister Pei?"
But then I thought about it, no, if it was Pei Yuyan, she wouldn't knock on the door so politely.
Sure enough, a familiar voice came from outside the door.
"It's me, Xuelan."
Ye Yun's eyes lit up and he immediately greeted him.
When I opened the door, I saw that it was indeed Senior Sister Xue Lan from the inner door. I hadn't seen her for a while.
I don't know if the injury has healed, but Senior Sister Xue Lan in front of me looks much rosier than last time.
Ye Yun immediately smiled and said hello.
"Senior Sister Xuelan, you are a rare visitor. Is your injury already healed?"
"Thanks to your elixir, I'm healed."
Xue Lan nodded slightly, then looked around and said.
"I came here this time to see where you, a powerful alchemist, usually live."
"Ahem, it's not that powerful."
Regarding the title of alchemist, Ye Yun still felt guilty.
Fortunately, Xue Lan's attention was not focused on this. In comparison, she was more concerned about the environment of the Wasted Alchemy Room.
After following Ye Yun in, she quickly frowned.
"It smells so weird. Are you going to live here all the time?"
"Yes, I'm used to it."
Ye Yun smiled faintly, but it made Xue Lan look at him with admiration.
With such alchemy skills, he can still calm down. Living in a place like this, no wonder he can achieve such success. He really has the demeanor of a master.
Xue Lan looked around and praised him.
"Now that I see it, I have some admiration for you."
Hearing this, Ye Yun chuckled.
"That's really an honor."
Due to the messy environment of the waste elixir room, the smell of waste elixir was everywhere.
Xue Lan searched for a long time, then reluctantly found a place that felt clean to sit down, and then asked Ye Yun.
"By the way, have you gone to see Senior Sister Mo? Did the meeting go well?"
